<script src='../assets/js/box2d.js'></script>
        <script src='../assets/js/physics.js'></script>
        <script src='../assets/js/plinko.js'></script>
        <script>
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
          const chKey = 'ch02'
          let jsBlocks = Array.from(
            document.querySelectorAll('pre')
          )
          jsBlocks
            .filter((elt) => !elt.classList.contains('default'))
            .forEach((elt, i) => {
              // Update cell content if in localStorage
              // console.log(elt)
              // console.log(i)
              const lsKey = `${chKey}-cell-${i}`
              // Store the original (pre-localStorage) content
              const lsKeyOrig = `${chKey}-cell-${i}-orig`
              const origContent = elt.innerText
              localStorage.setItem(lsKeyOrig, origContent)
              // console.log(`lsKey = ${lsKey}`)
              const savedContent = localStorage.getItem(lsKey) || ''
              // console.log(`savedContent: ${savedContent}`)
              if (savedContent != '') {
                // elt.firstChild.value = savedContent
                console.log(`Updating content to: ${savedContent}`)
                elt.innerHTML = `<pre>${savedContent}</pre>`
              }
              const result = editor.setup(elt, {
                language:'webppl',
                lineNumbers: true,
              })
              // console.log(result)
              // Listen for changes
              result.refs.editor.codeMirror.doc.on(
                "change",
                function(cm, changeObj) {
                  console.log(`Content changed in cell ${i}`)
                  // console.log(cm.getValue())
                  const newVal = cm.getValue()
                  localStorage.setItem(lsKey, newVal)
                }
              )
            })
          console.log('localStorage read')
          // And... a "reset to original" button
          const codeBlocks = document.querySelectorAll('div[id^=cb]')
          codeBlocks.forEach((elt, i) => {
            console.log(elt.id)
            // Add a "restore previous content" popup
            const restoreContainer = document.createElement('div')
            restoreContainer.setAttribute('style','display: flex;')
            // For debugging: a "view stored" button
            // const viewButton = document.createElement('button')
            // viewButton.textContent = 'View stored code'
            // viewButton.onclick = function() {
            //   console.log(`viewing ${i}`)
            //   const lsKey = `${chKey}-cell-${i}`
            //   const lsVal = localStorage.getItem(lsKey) || ''
            //   console.log(lsVal)
            //   alert(lsVal)
            // }
            // restoreContainer.append(viewButton)
            const restoreButton = document.createElement('button')
            restoreContainer.append(restoreButton)
            restoreButton.textContent = "Restore Original"
            restoreButton.setAttribute('style','margin-left: auto; font-size: 80%;')
            elt.style.marginTop = 0
            restoreButton.onclick = function() {
              console.log(`restoring ${i}`)
              console.log(elt)
              const cmObj = elt.firstChild.firstChild.firstChild.children[1].CodeMirror
              console.log(cmObj)
              // Use setValue to update the content
              const origValKey = `${chKey}-cell-${i}-orig`
              const origVal = localStorage.getItem(origValKey)
              cmObj.setValue(origVal)
            }
            // Add it before the current one
            elt.before(restoreContainer)
            console.log(elt)
            console.log(elt.children[0])
            const eltButtons = elt.querySelectorAll('button')
            console.log(eltButtons)
          })
          // console.log(document.querySelectorAll('.ReactCodeMirror'))
        })
        </script>
